findings.title: Equal-weight denominator ambiguous; dangling cross-reference to the cap law
findings.detail: Plan sec3 freezes 'equal weight w_i = min(1/N_eligible, cap law sec5)' but does not pin N_eligible to (a) the count of quintile book members or (b) the count of all eligible names. With membership defined as the top quintile, reading (b) dilutes the book ~5x into ~80% cash; every scored dollar number (net PnL, exposure, turnover, reported capacity AUM) changes with the reading even though ratio gates are scale-invariant. The cross-reference 'cap law sec5' points at sec5 (trial identity), while the participation-cap law actually lives in sec4 F6 - the freeze text cites its own cap law in the wrong place. A freeze whose weight law admits two defensible readings cannot reproduce a scored number.
findings.evidence_path_or_quote: plans/PLAN_stocks_amihud_v1.md sec3: 'book long-only, equal weight w_i = min(1/N_eligible, cap law sec5); membership = top quintile (>= 80th pct) of ILLIQ among eligible names at t'
findings.minimal_remediation_gap: The plan author must pin the weight denominator to one defined quantity (member count or eligible count, stated) and correct the cap-law cross-reference, before D1 freeze.

findings.title: Mid-fold death/delisting treatment of an open position is unpinned
findings.detail: Eligibility pins only 'served bar at t and t+1' at entry time; F4 counts in-horizon deaths (BC-7a census) but no clause fixes what happens to a POSITION in a name that stops serving mid-fold: sell at last served price with band cost, carry at last served price to the next rebalance/force-flat without cost, or mark to a -100% delisting return are all consistent with the text and differ by orders of magnitude on exactly the illiquid microcap tail this book selects. Delisting treatment is the classic confounder of measured illiquidity premia; leaving it unpinned lets the choice (made later, possibly after peeking) change scored numbers.
findings.evidence_path_or_quote: plans/PLAN_stocks_amihud_v1.md sec3 eligibility 'served bar at t and t+1 (else name skipped, counted)'; sec4 F4 'in-horizon death census per fold (BC-7a, counted BEFORE any scored computation)' - census only, no position-treatment law
findings.minimal_remediation_gap: The plan author must add a death-censoring law for open positions (price used, sell timing, cost event) to the frozen set before any PnL exists.

findings.title: F3b zero-division guard law excludes the anchor's own DV denominator; negative fixture does not test it
findings.detail: F3b is titled 'ZERO/NON-FINITE GUARD (every division)' but its operative sentence covers only 'EVERY division whose denominator is a price or adjusted price'. The anchor formula divides |r_i,d| by DV_i,d = P_i,d * V_i,d - a dollar volume, not a price - and zero-volume served sessions (routine in the microcap tail below the $2M floor and near it) produce DV=0. The sec8 negative test injects only 'adj_close==0 / inf / NaN' price fixtures into anchor/neighbour/control/benchmark paths; a DV==0 fixture is not required. STOCKS-SEARCH-V1 died (TECHABORT_3) precisely at a division site outside its enumerated guard law; this plan reproduces the same structural hole in its own primary formula. Other non-price denominators (e.g. zero realized vol in the beta/vol attribution) are equally outside the letter of the law.
findings.evidence_path_or_quote: plans/PLAN_stocks_amihud_v1.md sec4 F3b: 'Before EVERY division whose denominator is a price or adjusted price ...'; sec3 formula: 'ILLIQ_i,t = mean ... of |r_i,d| / DV_i,d'; sec8: 'inject adj_close==0 / inf / NaN fixtures'
findings.minimal_remediation_gap: The plan author must widen the F3b guard law (and the sec8 negative fixtures) from price/adjusted-price denominators to every division site without exception, explicitly naming DV==0 and zero-variance denominators, matching the law's own title.

findings.title: ADV-band cost classifier statistic unpinned; cited lineage does not define it
findings.detail: F6 freezes the band schedule {A:10, B:15, C:25} bps on 'ADV bands {50M, 10M, 2M}' citing 'RULES sec9 lineage', but RULES.md sec9 in this tree is the 'Mechanism status ladder' and contains no cost bands; no clause in the plan states which estimator assigns a name to a band (trailing 60-session median DV as used for eligibility/cap, trailing mean ADV, what window, evaluated at decision or fill). Boundary names flip A/B or B/C, moving per-fill cost by 5-10 bps against expected net edges - a tunable that changes scored net numbers. Every other quantity in the plan that needs a dollar-volume statistic explicitly names 'trailing 60-session median DV'; the cost band does not.

findings.minimal_remediation_gap: The plan author must pin the band-assignment statistic, window and evaluation instant (or cite a real authority that defines them) in the frozen cost contract.

findings.title: Reopening-law reading is generous: NG6 clause literally requires a 'changed killer', not a 'new family'
findings.detail: The STOCKS-NG6 terminal clause (registry phase and MAP.md) reads 'reopening: materially new evidenced source or owner plan naming a changed killer'. This cycle names a NEW family, not a changed killer, and sec2 calls this 'the second reserved branch (owner plan)'. The cycle is nonetheless lawful because authority order #1 (explicit owner instruction 2026-09-23, registered in CYCLE_REGISTRY.events.jsonl 2026-09-23T05:06:39Z) supersedes derived frontier law, and the law's substance - ancestry protection via the immovable 0.20 D2 bar - is preserved verbatim. Recorded so the generous wording is not later cited as precedent without the owner-instruction foundation.

findings.detail: The calendar fires 'every 21 trading sessions from the first eligible decision date', but no clause fixes a minimum membership for a bookable decision date, nor whether a date whose eligible set (or quintile) is empty is skipped or counts toward the F8 '>= 30 bookable decisions per fold' floor. findings.title: Quintile threshold algorithm and winsorization stance unstated
findings.detail: '>= 80th pct' does not name the percentile algorithm (interpolated vs rank-count); ties at the threshold are broken by name, which restores determinism only given the threshold. Winsorization is nowhere mentioned; because membership and the reversal control are rank-based and weights are equal, winsorization is near-moot - but the freeze should say 'none' so absence is not read as freedom.

findings.title: Served-session gap inflates |r| inside the ILLIQ mean by construction
findings.detail: The formation window averages over 'the D=21 most recent served sessions', so a return spanning a multi-week halt enters as one observation and inflates ILLIQ for gappy names. The law is deterministic (no ambiguity), and F4's gap census exists; disclosure of the interaction in the final report would complete the honesty chain.

verdict_rationale: Four unresolved HIGH findings (H-1 weight-denominator ambiguity + dangling cap-law reference; H-2 unpinned mid-fold death treatment of open positions; H-3 zero-division guard law that by its own letter excludes the anchor's DV==0 denominator and whose negative fixture does not test it - the exact un-enumerated-division-site class that killed STOCKS-SEARCH-V1; H-4 unpinned ADV-band cost classifier with a dangling RULES sec9 lineage). Each could change a scored number or make a gate non-fail-closed, so under the audit rules any unresolved HIGH forces REFUSED. The cycle's legality, ancestry honesty, fold law, trial accounting, GO law, boundaries and honesty clauses are all sound (A/D/G/H/I/J/K/L PASS), and the four gaps are plan-text gaps remediable by the plan author before D1 freeze - none requires touching data, code or scored outcomes (none exist). This audit adjudicates the PLAN only; implementation has not begun and no outcome exists anywhere.
